items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Edward G. Robinson brought Mr. Bate, Fred Bate in, and Mr. Bate heard me sing

ctx.x: Oh, yes. See? After I came back from Showboat, I -- well, while I was in London, Mr. -- when I was

in Paris, just before -- I had gone from Showboat over to Paris again for a little while, and I was singing in Fred Payne's bar, and Edward G. Robinson brought Mr. Bate, Fred Bate in, and Mr. Bate heard me sing, and he told me anytime I was ready to come back to New York to just let him know.

Well, I thought it was a little talk, you know, and you know how you think people promise you things. So then I went back to London, and while I was at the Palladium -- I believe I was at the Palladium -- Mr. -- I was either at the Palladium or I -- or either singing with Jack Jackson at the Dorchester, but I think I was at the Palladium, because I -- they arranged a date for me to record -- I mean to broadcast from London to New York, and Leslie Hutchinson played for me.
